# betteredge_port_forwarding (Resource)

A single port forwarding rule on a BetterEdge TED.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "betteredge_port_forwarding" "example" {
  vm_id    = betteredge_ted.example.id
  port     = "8443"
  protocol = "tcp"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `port` (String) Port to forward.
- `vm_id` (String) UUID of the VM to update.

### Optional

- `protocol` (String) tcp or udp.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Synthetic identifier (`<vm_id>/<port>`) - the platform API has no per-rule ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import betteredge_port_forwarding.example 9bf980e3-f691-4edf-b43a-eefc25f8c9f5/8443
```
